text:
alex.sales: Heads-up — Hoist (prospect) wants a quick POC to migrate from CompetitorX. Main asks: prompt parity, response deltas, token billing differences, and a security questionnaire. Can we outline next steps?

maria.se: +1. I did an initial smoke yesterday. Two immediate quirks: (1) CompetitorX streams chunk boundaries differently which affects our streaming client; (2) their tokenization counts fewer tokens for certain prompts.

jordan.pdm: For the POC we should scope: input mapping (headers, stop tokens), streaming compatibility, deterministic mode tests, and billing delta analysis. Also request they share 10 representative prompts and expected outputs.

hoist_cto: Thanks — we can share prompts. Also need to understand idempotency behavior for retries and how 429/backoff works vs what we get now.

maria.se: Good call. Action items: 1) Maria to set up proxy shim to mimic CompetitorX endpoint mapping; 2) Alex to confirm pricing scenario (tokens vs per-request). 3) Sam to prefill security Q.

sam.security: I'll answer the questionnaire but quick flags: Hoist requires SAML SSO, KMS for key rotation, and SOC2 scope. Also they'll want ingress IP allowlist and audit logs for model inputs. Any special notes on data-in-flight encryption for Dedicated?

jordan.pdm: Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS and VPC peering — note that on-prem/offline variants will add lead time. We'll document latency SLO differences.

alex.sales: Pricing — they asked about delta if responses are slightly longer because of tokenization. We should run sample prompts and report per-1M token cost under current and projected token counts, and show a mitigation: prefix caching + quantized cheaper model fallback for low-fidelity calls.

maria.se: I'll run the 10 prompts through both our public tokenizer and CompetitorX's (we have a script) and produce a table. Quick snippet I used to compare token counts:

```
# compare_token_counts.sh
for p in prompts.txt; do
  echo "PROMPT: $p";
  ./token_counter_redwood.py "$p";
  ./token_counter_compx.py "$p";
done
```

jordan.pdm: Also log streaming chunk sizes. Some of Hoist's UI expects line-delimited partials; CompetitorX sends smaller micro-chunks causing different cursor behavior. We should propose a client-side glue or advise a minimal SDK tweak.

hoist_cto: We can't change the client fast; prefer server-side shim. Can you emulate their chunking?

maria.se: Yes, proxy can buffer and re-chunk to match their current behavior. Will add a config flag so we can toggle.

sam.security: On the security Q: are we comfortable publishing an RBAC MVP for POC access? They want granular role separation (read-only analytics vs inference tokens).

jordan.pdm: For POC we can provide scoped API keys and a read-only dashboard role. Full RBAC would be an enterprise add-on. Call this out in the SOW.

alex.sales: Timeline ask from Hoist: two-week POC with smoke at day 3 and final report on day 12. Is that realistic?

maria.se: Two weeks OK if they provide prompts and a short test dataset now. I can spin a POC proxy and test harness in a day, but security/KMS setup might push timeline for Dedicated.

sam.security: If they need customer-managed KMS and VPC, budget at least 2–3 weeks for networking approvals. POC can run on Hosted with telemetry turned on while we parallelize infra for Dedicated.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: se/proxy-mimic v1.2 -> staging at 1714220500 :white_check_mark:

alex.sales: Great. For the deliverables I propose: (1) POC proxy URL + instructions, (2) tokenization and billing delta report, (3) streaming chunk compatibility config, (4) security Q answers + SOW note on Dedicated timeline, (5) short appendix on fallback model/quantization to reduce cost.

hoist_cto: That covers it. Also want telemetry labels in responses so we can attribute tokens to features. Can you add a response header X-Redwood-Feature or include metadata in the streaming preface?

maria.se: We can add a metadata preface on the stream and a header. Will add a sample curl for them:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <POC_KEY>" \
     -H "X-Client-Feature: compose.v2" \
     https://proxy.redwood/test/stream?model=rw-lite-quant
```

jordan.pdm: Also include a small eval harness to measure semantic drift: BLEU/ROUGE + a fingerprinting diff to surface shifted phrasing. That will help quantify parity issues.

sam.security: I'll draft security answers and ping legal for export control clauses. Hoist: can you confirm which compliance docs you need (SOC2 Type II, ISO27001, HIPAA)?

hoist_cto: SOC2 + HIPAA is required. ISO desirable.

maria.se: Noted. I'll post the initial token-count table and streaming logs by EOD.

alex.sales: I'll draft the SOW and pricing scenarios (best/likely/worst token delta). Assigning tasks: Maria (POC proxy + token report), Sam (security Q), Jordan (eval harness + SDK shim guidance), Alex (SOW + pricing). Meeting Friday 11am to review. :thumbsup:

hoist_cto: Friday 11am works. Thanks team.

alex.sales: Closing loop — ping if blockers.
